title: Horses, Cows, Goats and Sheep
translation: From it horses were born, and all animals with two rows of teeth. Cows were born from it; from it came goats and sheep.
translation_hi: उससे घोड़े उत्पन्न हुए और वे सब पशु जिनके दोनों ओर दाँत होते हैं। उससे गायें उत्पन्न हुईं, और उससे बकरियाँ और भेड़ें।
science: 'Teeth in both jaws': the hymn sorts animals by their teeth, the same feature zoologists use. Cows, goats and sheep have no upper front teeth, while horses do.
